value.contract: MPLFeaturesUtils, MapDrawable and all six MLP background constructors project separate native property maps while retaining rich Java editor features and full geometry/IDs/unknowns. Polygon label sources omit empty signatures and geometry paint; point sources keep combined roles and lines retain query fallback inputs. Uniform sparsity needs exact factory-default context; rules retain actual consumers, zoom curves/layout keys/gates. App verification fixture observes this transport projection without weakening rich Java or GPU assertions; source/URI/edit paths cannot bypass it.
